newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ C 333 OF NOVEMBER 7, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ C 333 OF NOVEMBER 7, 1996.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

Common position (EC) No 60/96 of 27 September 1996 adopted by the Council, acting in accordance with the procedure referred to in Article 189b of the Treaty establishing the European Community, with a view to adopting a Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council on consumer protection in the indication of the prices of products offered to consumers

Common position (EC) No 59/96 of 23 July 1996 adopted by the Council, acting in accordance with the procedure referred to in Article 189b of the Treaty establishing the European Community, with a view to adopting a Council Regulation continuing a special system of assistance to traditional ACP suppliers of bananas established by Regulation (EC) No 2686/94 END OF DOCUMENT.
